title: Qualify six-source electrochemical Standard calendar NuGet candidate with independent binary consumer
commitMessage: test: qualify electrochemical Standard NuGet candidate and twelve binary checks

contribution.summary: Qualify a new immutable, unpublished dw.quantities.standard calendar package carrying the six-unit opt-in Math electrochemical profile through an isolated exact PackageReference-only binary consumer.
contribution.value: Build the next unoccupied on-date Standard NuGet candidate from six source files with two exact published dependencies. Verify real ZIP/nuspec and all archive SHA-256 identities, load three matching compiled DLLs through an independent consumer, pass twelve named binary probes and record actual local restore sources.
debtChanges: RS173 succeeded at attempt 001 after a single pre-attempt refusal: twelve Math-owned source tests passed and the six-unit opt-in profile was compiled, but no new package was qualified.
Preserve published Standard [20260.20261103.1001], Quantities [20260.20261102.1001] and Expression [20260.20261102.1001] bytes, five original Standard sources, and exact direct dependencies.
AURA code reuse rights remain unestablished. No AURA source, old catalogue, license/SPDX, shared feed or sibling repository is modified by this candidate-only gate.

The independent package-only consumer operates against the candidate and exact old dependencies, not a published delivery; later owner-authorized immutable publication and independent physical-feed readback remain mandatory.

RS174 first invocation failed pre-attempt with nested_repository_refused: the shared private-feed reader refuses unrelated child directories by default. The same run now explicitly selects nonrecursive top-level-only inventory with full package/hash checks.

RS174 second invocation failed pre-attempt with invalid_package: shared List(PackageId) inspects unrelated packages before filtering. Corrected with bounded Standard filename inventory, pinned feed-path safety, exact historical archive SHA, and isolated candidate inspection.

RS174 third invocation failed pre-attempt: consumer-release-build CS0165 for mole variable m behind short-circuit &&. Split the two real catalogue lookups into separate required checks; retain all twelve binary probes, exact dependencies and archive/DLL SHA gates.
contribution.nextAction: Qualify an original-candidate-only immutable private publisher and publish only identical bytes into NUGET_LOCAL without overwrite under the U-N delivery authorization; independently re-read published archives and all three loaded DLLs.
